'''Ronald G. Bruno''' is an American businessman. He was the [[Chairperson|chairman]] and [[chief executive officer]] of [[Bruno's]], and was the co-founder and chairman of the [[Regions Charity Classic|Bruno Event Team]].

In 2009, Bruno was inducted into the [[Alabama Sports Hall of Fame]].<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://abhof.culverhouse.ua.edu/member/ronald-g-bruno/|title=Ronald G. Bruno|work=Alabama Business Hall of Fame|access-date=May 28, 2026}}</ref>
